name: HiddenForm
headline: Piece by piece.
A little more wonder.
description: Discover artful wooden puzzles, curious shapes, and a calmer kind of play.
detail: Choose an illustrated animal, find where each wooden piece belongs, and bring the whole picture to life. A little challenge, a little patience, and something beautiful at the end.
screenAlt: Actual HiddenForm screen showing the koi wooden puzzle, puzzle choices and piece counts, with a Preparing your video message.
facts: Find the shape
Discover illustrated animal silhouettes with pieces that reward a closer look.
Choose your pace
Pick from different piece counts for a relaxed or more intricate puzzle.
A moment to unwind
Enjoy a quiet puzzle table on your phone or tablet.

name: Prism Lines
headline: One move.
A whole new possibility.
description: Match colors, clear lines, and find your flow. From a quick daily challenge to one more round.
detail: Place shapes in Classic, slide matching colors together in Connect, or chase your next high score in Rush. Take on daily challenges and discover elemental piece styles as you play.
screenAlt: Actual Prism Lines Connect level 27 screen showing colored gems, obstacles, move limit, undo and hint controls.
facts: Find your mode
Classic, Connect, Rush, Workshop and more offer different ways to challenge yourself.
Make it a daily ritual
Play Daily Prism and the daily Connect challenge.
Make every move count
Discover elemental forms, build combos, and use hints or undo when you need them.

name: Kyndlo
headline: Find your people.
Share your world.
description: Connect through personality, shared interests, and real-world experiences.
detail: Discover your spirit animal, meet people who share your interests, and give new friendships a place to grow through activities and meaningful conversations.
screenAlt: Kyndlo Quests screen showing the Speakeasy Golf Lounge Discovery Quest, challenges, XP and Join Quest action.
availability: Android open testing · iOS coming soon
facts: Start with who you are
Explore personality and shared interests through your spirit animal.
Find common ground
Connect with people through experiences and activities you enjoy.
Meet beyond the screen
Make room for real-world friendships and meaningful conversations.

name: Daily Spirit
headline: A little space
for yourself.
description: Oracle & Puzzle. A daily ritual of reflection and discovery.
detail: Hold an intention, swirl the deck, and let a card find you. Piece its artwork together, discover its meaning, and keep a private journal of your cards and reflections.
screenAlt: Daily Oracle home screen showing the Presence heron card, View Details, Your Journey and journal navigation.
facts: Set an intention
Start with a quiet moment and trace slow circles over the deck.
Piece it together
Complete a jigsaw of your card’s artwork before its reveal.
Carry it with you
Explore the card’s meaning and record your reflections in a private journal.
